WITH per_patient AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM per_patient
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT ID, ratio, ratio - avg_ratio AS difference
  FROM per_patient
  CROSS JOIN overall
  WHERE ratio > avg_ratio
),
avg_above AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM above_overall
),
above_second AS (
  SELECT ID, ratio, difference, ratio - avg_ratio AS difference2
  FROM above_overall
  CROSS JOIN avg_above
  WHERE ratio > avg_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(ratio), AVG(difference), AVG(difference2)
FROM above_second
